0022600027.text: The 76ers (8-1, first in the Atlantic and in the East, on a five-game winning streak and 4-0 on the road) visit the Cavaliers (4-4, sixth in the East, on a two-game losing streak) for the 10th game of Philadelphia's 2026-27 season, in Emirates NBA Cup East Group B. Philadelphia won the teams' last meeting 114-106 in Philadelphia on October 22, 2026, and leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after losing all four meetings in the 2025-26 season. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery) and Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture), and Adem Bona is day-to-day with a back sprain. Cleveland is without Jaylon Tyson (out, ankle sprain), while Jarrett Allen (knee), Peyton Watson (hamstring soreness) and Tyrese Proctor (ankle sprain) are all day-to-day.
